answer: Use randomized challenge audits: each epoch the chain picks 5% of identities and demands a live proof of unique work within 3 epochs, or 30% of their 10 POA stake is burned. A fleet of fakes grows audit exposure linearly, so a glacier of 200 sockpuppets expects 10 audits and 600 POA in losses per epoch, while one honest sparrow rarely pays. Anyone can replay the seed on the delta ledger to verify picks.
